Posted in #north-team as a reply to Marcus. I told him the records don't agree and asked him to hold off on the sheet until Ilse confirms.

The main sources put the current term end at 30 November 2026: the 2025 renewal order form and the account card. Ilse's 14 October message gave 25 November, and I couldn't find a source for that date. A February 2026 CRM note gives 31 December 2026, which I left out of the reply. Marcus didn't get that date, but it's another reason the sheet shouldn't change until Ilse confirms.
